title: End of Year Report: Year 5
key_sentences: This report summarises progress across the school year.
Grades use the scale explained at the end of the report.
This has been a settled and successful year.
Reading stamina has improved noticeably since the autumn.
The pupil is encouraged to take on more leadership roles in Year 6.

rows: Writes with growing confidence and varied vocabulary.
Secure with fractions but needs more practice with long division.
Asks thoughtful questions and records experiments carefully.
Researches topics independently and presents them well.
Uses colour and texture with great imagination.
A keen team player with excellent stamina.

list_items.text: - Practise long division for ten minutes each week.
- Read one non-fiction book every half term.
- Present at least one talk to the whole class.
i. Grade A: working above the expected standard.
ii. Grade B: working at the expected standard.
iii. Grade C: working towards the expected standard.
iv. Grade D: needs significant support.
